title: Nightly investigator verdict
description: Exactly one verdict from the [Nightly] e2e-red-<date> investigator agent spawned by scripts/nightly-e2e.sh. PASS means the root cause was independently verified (tests re-run, culprit commit re-read) and a fix plan exists; FAIL means the investigation was inconclusive.

run.description: Nightly run stamp from the spawn prompt (e.g. "20260905-033001").

tested_sha.description: origin/main commit the nightly run tested.

culprit_sha.description: The commit you verified as the culprit. Empty string when the bot's bisect was inconclusive and you could not attribute one.

verdict.description: PASS only when you re-ran the failing specs yourself and the root cause is verified with evidence. FAIL = inconclusive.

root_cause.description: One paragraph: what broke, why, which commit introduced it, and whether it is a code regression or an un-updated test expectation.

evidence.description: Each command you ran and the decisive part of its output. Must include the re-run of the failing specs.

plan_path.description: Absolute path to the phased fix plan you wrote (empty string on FAIL).

drift.description: "detected" when the failure is an un-updated expectation (deliberate product change the spec never followed) rather than a code regression.

next_action.description: delegate_fix when a full-auto paseo-delegate run can execute the plan; escalate when a human must decide (drift with product questions, flaky infra, inconclusive).

next_prompt.description: One line for the morning report: what the delegate run will do (or why it cannot). Empty string on FAIL.
